newsitem.title: USA: GE Capital acquires UK technology company.
newsitem.headline: GE Capital acquires UK technology company.

text.p: GE Capital IT Solutions, a unit of GE Capital Services Co, said on Thursday that it acquired Systems International, an information technology provider and systems reseller, in Britain.

GE said that Systems International, which has revenues of about $70 million, offers a broad range of PC desktop, workstation, network and outsourcing services to large national and international organizations.
GE Capital Services is a wholly owned subsidiary of General Electric Co.
It did not discuss terms of the transaction, and a company spokesman was not immediately available.
